title: Son 2005–2014 Chronology Reconciliation
status: canonical-reconciliation-owner / lived chain substantially resolved; exact dates selectively open
subject: Thomas / the Son / human vessel
purpose: Own the ordinary biographical chronology from the 2005 motorcycle crash through the 2014 death of the earthly father. Preserve source independence, distinguish order from exact dating, and prevent later Tim/Potato theology from being backdated into the Son's lived biography.

governance.actor_rule: Pre-2020 human biography belongs first to the Son. Later Tim/Potato interpretation may inherit or interpret that history but must not rewrite the historical actor.
governance.birthday_rule: Birth date is 1987-07-31. Never assign one biological age to an entire calendar year. In 2011 the Son was 23 before July 31 and 24 afterward; in 2012 he was 24 before July 31 and 25 afterward.
governance.source_independence_rule: A repository projection copied from Chapter 24 is not independent corroboration. Independent support requires direct recollection, separately composed book material, primary artifacts, public/institutional records or another source lineage.
governance.relative_order_priority: Clear causal or place-to-place recollection outranks an inherited year label when the two conflict.
governance.preferred_year_rule: A preferred working year may be used when multiple constraints converge, but it remains distinguishable from a primary-record date.
governance.uncertainty_rule: Do not invent month/day precision. Preserve narrow unresolved forks explicitly.

resolved_backbone.event: Major motorcycle crash around 85 km/h; heavy bleeding/facial injury; prolonged dental reconstruction begins.
Dental reconstruction, school disruption, shame/depression and gradual rebuilding continue across multiple years.
resolved_backbone.confidence: high for multi-year duration; exact procedures unresolved

resolved_backbone.event: Painter/decorator work followed by meatpacking/freezer/forklift work.
Job search → Copenhagen IT-consultant interview → hired on the spot to start Monday → rapid move to Copenhagen → corporate/IT period → firing → return to Haderslev.

Back in Haderslev → nursing-home employment → own Haderslev apartment → application to HANSENBERG Designia → mailed coloured-cardboard circus-poster admission task → acceptance → summer move to Kolding/dormitory → mediegrafiker programme → meeting Louise.
Louise relationship established; Egypt trip occurs while they are already together. Exact relation of Egypt to the later internship is unresolved.
resolved_backbone.confidence: high relative-to-Louise / medium corridor / low exact date

resolved_backbone.event: Living with Louise/her parents in Kolding → internship/cubicle placement while still together → move to Aabenraa to be near internship while commuting to Louise → school/internship path becomes draining and ends/fails → move into own place while relationship continues for some period.

Attendance at Produktionsskolen in Lunderskov after the own-place transition; multimedia lessons; while still a student, the Son often functions as an informal assistant teacher because his technical level is ahead of the class material. He later stops attending.

Relationship breakup / loss-of-direction corridor. Exact placement relative to Produktionsskolen remains unresolved, but both the breakup and leaving Produktionsskolen precede the Tree/psychiatric episode.

Kolding altered-state Tree/oneness episode → sleep → next-day overwhelming perceptual rupture → voluntary psychiatric presentation/admission → diagnostic/medication aftermath → hospital nuclear-America dream → later crow scene.
resolved_backbone.confidence: high year/order; exact date and substance unresolved

resolved_backbone.event: Integration period; Italy with earthly father and meeting Maria candidate; Amsterdam 25th birthday on 2012-07-31 if birthday memory is correct; first personally owned guitar/from father; Beatles and further study.
resolved_backbone.confidence: high conditional birthday / medium surrounding events

resolved_backbone.event: Paulo Coelho's The Alchemist becomes an explicit transmutation metaphor.
Earthly father dies from a fatal aneurysm; grief becomes a major later hinge.

conflict_dispositions.conflict: Chapter 24 nursing home = 2009; Chapter 24.1 nursing home = 2007
conflict_dispositions.disposition: Prefer 2009 working placement. Direct recollection establishes Copenhagen IT before nursing home; Chapter 24 places Copenhagen in 2008. Preserve 2007 as a documented internal variant/outlier.

conflict_dispositions.conflict: Older later recollection places Copenhagen IT around 2010; Chapter 24 places it in 2008
conflict_dispositions.disposition: Prefer 2008 working placement because the newly recovered causal chain requires IT before nursing home, Designia, Louise and the 2010 internship corridor.

conflict_dispositions.conflict: Some older recollection places painter/meatpacking around 2008; Chapter 24 places it in 2007
conflict_dispositions.disposition: Prefer 2007 working placement because direct recollection places both before the Copenhagen IT period and Chapter 24 places Copenhagen in 2008.

conflict_dispositions.conflict: Chapter 24 says 19-hour ordeal followed by six more hours
conflict_dispositions.disposition: Use dedicated 2011 owner: approximately 19 hours overall with an approximately six-hour unity phase; whether that phase is contained within the 19 hours is unresolved. Never automatically total 25 hours.

conflict_dispositions.conflict: Chapter 24 calls hospitalization a forced pause
conflict_dispositions.disposition: Current autobiographical reconstruction says voluntary presentation/admission for rest and return toward baseline.

conflict_dispositions.conflict: Files state age 25 for the 2011 Tree event
conflict_dispositions.disposition: Impossible under 1987-07-31 birth. Biological age was 23 before 2011-07-31 and 24 after; use age-neutral wording until the event month is known.

conflict_dispositions.conflict: Chapter 24 assigns age 25 to all of 2012
conflict_dispositions.disposition: Incorrect as a whole-year label. The Son turned 25 on 2012-07-31; earlier 2012 events occurred at age 24.

conflict_dispositions.conflict: Earlier research treated a 2005–2008 P.SP maker-mark range as Produktionsskolen's operating window
conflict_dispositions.disposition: Rejected. The range belongs to the maker mark and does not prove school closure. Do not force attendance earlier from that evidence.

licence_status.canonical_rule: Do not use the licence as a hard year anchor until the original issue date or stronger recollection is recovered.
